messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Issue with Control.Fixed Parameter
parts:
you're creating a bimodal example, as there is a spike in the prior and
then one which fits data.

its more clear if you remove 'abs()' from the data creation, but the
result is the same.

the solution you get will depend on initial values, which are data-
driven, so this is why

parts:
yes, its all about 'domain of attraction' when you have a posterior with
two clear modes.


the newer versions use different initial values, as it solves simplified
model to get some better initial values for the latent.
